runner: Codex in-app browser against isolated enabled and no-key fixture servers, backed by Phase 5 schema, generation, API and security suites

cases.expected: Xugu campaign shell shows project-scoped validated proposals and generation tasks
cases.actual: The Xugu shell retained v4.2 campaign language and displayed one validated proposal plus one succeeded locked generation task

cases.expected: Standard project terms and an isolated empty proposal workspace
cases.actual: The standard project rendered 团队, 任务, 里程碑 and 项目更新提案 with zero Xugu proposal rows

cases.expected: Only ready, current, explicitly granted, same-template materials can be selected
cases.actual: The generation sheet exposed one granted ready meeting-note source, locked the published v4.2 base and showed the 8-material and 48-evidence bounds

cases.expected: A valid provider result creates one durable task and one validated proposal without changing version pointers
cases.actual: The seeded provider task succeeded with one call and 150 tokens; API acceptance confirmed published and draft pointers were unchanged

cases.expected: Proposal detail shows schema validation, bounded semantic deltas, confidence and warnings
cases.actual: The detail rendered all six server validation gates, one task-network create delta, field patch, 0.82 confidence and explicit warning state

cases.expected: Each change links exact immutable evidence back to its source locator
cases.actual: The change cited one stable evidence ID labeled 人工材料 · 正文; following it opened the exact material block and source text

cases.expected: Missing dedicated generation configuration disables submission while preserving materials and prior tasks
cases.actual: The sheet stated 更新生成当前未启用, left the granted material visible, disabled generation and preserved the retryable task record

cases.expected: Read, grant, create and retry capabilities follow project roles and CSRF protection
cases.actual: Platform admin controls matched server capabilities; API role tests denied viewer mutations, editor grants and non-member or cross-project object guesses

cases.expected: Project switching clears proposal, task, material and terminology state
cases.actual: The switcher moved from the populated Xugu workspace to an empty standard workspace with standard-only copy and no Xugu proposal data

cases.expected: Phase 5 exposes no accept, reject, edit, draft merge, publish or rollback action
cases.actual: The proposal detail was read-only and explicitly said it had not changed draft or published data; route and UI suites found no Phase 6 mutation surface

cases.expected: Proposal validation and change detail remain readable at the tablet breakpoint
cases.actual: The header, local module tabs, proposal boundary notice and validation card reflowed without clipped controls or horizontal page overflow

cases.expected: Mobile proposal detail preserves project identity, navigation, validation status and evidence access
cases.actual: The compact header, locally scrollable modules, wrapped proposal ID, validation badge and evidence content remained reachable and legible

cases.expected: Executable fields, oversized output, invalid evidence and cross-project IDs fail closed and render only as text
cases.actual: Schema, validator and API suites rejected executable-looking fields, extra keys, oversized output, fabricated evidence and cross-project IDs; the UI uses safe text nodes

cases.expected: No application browser warnings, errors or JavaScript dialogs
cases.actual: Application warning count 0; error count 0; dialog count 0 across enabled and no-key servers

cases.expected: Reference HEAD, clean status and seed hash remain unchanged
